items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Er muss binnen zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Polizei Berlin (Muster) – Bußgeldstelle eingelegt werden.
items.computation: The attached Zustellungsurkunde (page 2) shows actual delivery ('zugestellt am') on 11.12.2025 (Thursday), so that is the day of Zustellung rather than a fictional delivery date. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the two-week period starts the day after delivery, i.e. 12.12.2025. Two weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) is Thursday 25.12.2025 (Erster Weihnachtstag), a public holiday in Berlin, and the following day, Friday 26.12.2025 (Zweiter Weihnachtstag), is also a holiday; Saturday 27.12. and Sunday 28.12. are non-business days. Under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG the deadline therefore shifts to the next business day, Monday 29.12.2025.

items.title: Pay the total fine, fee and expenses (Gesamtbetrag)
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, fällig; geben Sie bei der Überweisung bitte das Aktenzeichen an.
items.computation: The notice becomes rechtskräftig (final) once the two-week Einspruch period expires without an objection having been filed. That period ends 29.12.2025 (see the Einspruch item), so the notice becomes final on 30.12.2025 (Tuesday), assuming no Einspruch was lodged. Payment is due two weeks after that: under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB counting starts the day after, 31.12.2025, and two weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) is Tuesday 13.01.2026, a normal business day in Berlin, so no shift applies.

warnings: Both computed dates (Einspruch deadline 29.12.2025 and payment due 13.01.2026) lie well before today (26.09.2026); check whether an Einspruch was actually filed and whether this fine has already been paid, since the payment deadline assumes no objection was lodged.

The IBAN printed for payment (DE07 1005 0000 0000 9900 07) is a formally valid German IBAN; before paying, compare it with the account used on other genuine correspondence from this authority, since this is a specimen/fictional letter and the account cannot be independently verified here.
